crossRefs.note: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

translations.web: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
translations.bsb: They send forth their little ones like a flock; their children skip about,
translations.kjv: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
translations.asv: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.
